description: Roads by country (OCHA West and Central Africa, on HDX) is a series of datasets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA West and Central Africa (ROWCA). The present geodata represents the roads network of Mauritania. Coverage: 8 countries and territories, one dataset each (for example Benin, Congo, Côte d'Ivoire, Cabo Verde). The portal lists 8 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA West and Central Africa (ROWCA). Its tags are geodata, roads, transportation. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-04-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
